title: Home page
description: Landing page with one entry point per use case: stress simulation, yard simulation, check-in logs, and an Ollama chat test.

title: Global LLM model picker
description: The model picker in the top bar lists the models installed in the local Ollama; the selected model is used by every AI feature.

title: Ollama connection test
description: A plain chat page for checking that the local LLM is reachable before using the AI features.

title: Ollama connection test — answer
description: The test chat answering, confirming the LLM connection works end to end.

title: Backend API documentation (Swagger)
description: Interactive OpenAPI documentation served by the backend at https://backend.localhost/swagger, for integrating simulators and data sources.

title: Backend API endpoints
description: The endpoint list for education, yard logistics and log ingestion.
